name: Hart Electric
old_description: Hart Electric specializes in off-road and custom applications such as mining, agriculture and industrial. .
about:
Hart Electric has operated from Lostant, Illinois since 1984. The company was founded that year and has since focused on wire harness and cable assembly for off-road and custom applications.

The shop builds wire harnesses and cables to customer specifications, offering a suite of value-added processes: computer-aided continuity testing, sonic splicing with an advanced sonic welder, custom thermal-transfer marking on heat-shrink tubing (0.25″ to 4″ lengths, 1/16″ to 2″ sizes), hot tin dipping for copper and copper alloys, nylon braiding (24 to 36 strands), and hot stamping for wire sizes from 8 AWG to 18 AWG. The company emphasizes fast quoting and quick turnaround for time-sensitive orders.

Hart Electric serves mining, agriculture, industrial, and other off-road equipment sectors. Customers include manufacturers of custom off-road machinery who require harnesses built to exacting specifications and delivered within tight schedules.

The company's stated promise is that “your project will become our project; your sense of urgency becomes ours,” backed by a management team available to address concerns. Plant manager John Hartenbower oversees operations, and the firm highlights its commitment to quality craftsmanship and incorporating the latest assembly technologies.
